This vignette provides a runnable short test for the end-to-end model fit with simulation, fit, prediction/simulation and benchmark to standard models for a normal margin with normal copula over 3 timepoint observations of 20 subjects.

```{r working-install}
library(gamlss.longitudinal)
library(gamlss.dist)

dat <- simulate_longitudinal_dataset(
  n = 20,
  times = 0:2,
  margin_dist = NO(),
  copula_dist = "N",
  margin_params = list(mu = function(d) 1 + 0.2 * d$time, sigma = 0.6),
  copula_params = list(theta = 0.25),
  seed = 1
)

fit <- gamlss_longitudinal(
  data = dat,
  margin_dist = NO(),
  copula_dist = "N",
  time_var = "time",
  subject_var = "subject",
  optimization = "joint",
  mu.formula = response ~ time,
  sigma.formula = ~ 1,
  theta.formula = ~ 1,
  optimizer_control = gamlss_longitudinal_control(
    max_outer_iter = 5,
    rs = list(max_inner_iter = 5)
  ),
  compute_vcov = FALSE,
  verbose = 0
)

mean_prediction <- predict(fit, type = "mean")
quantile_prediction <- predict(
  fit,
  type = "quantile",
  probs = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)
)
probability_prediction <- predict(
  fit,
  type = "probability",
  q = 1,
  direction = "above"
)
quantile_columns <- grep("^q[0-9]", names(quantile_prediction), value = TRUE)

head(mean_prediction)
head(quantile_prediction)
head(probability_prediction)

model_check <- check_model(fit, include_vcov = FALSE)
copula_check <- suppressMessages(plot_copula_diagnostics(
  fit,
  type = "all",
  residual_lags = 1:2,
  plot = FALSE
))
names(copula_check$plots)
report <- reporting_table(fit, dat, by = "time", threshold = 1)
specification <- model_spec(fit)

sim <- simulate(fit, nsim = 2, seed = 1)
head(sim)

benchmark <- benchmark_standard_models(
  data = dat,
  formula = response ~ time,
  subject_var = "subject",
  family = "gaussian",
  comparators = "glm",
  fit = fit
)

stopifnot(
  inherits(fit, "gamlss.longitudinal"),
  isTRUE(fit$convergence$converged),
  is.finite(as.numeric(logLik(fit))),
  length(mean_prediction) == nrow(dat),
  all(is.finite(mean_prediction)),
  nrow(quantile_prediction) == nrow(dat),
  length(quantile_columns) == 3L,
  all(is.finite(as.matrix(quantile_prediction[quantile_columns]))),
  nrow(probability_prediction) == nrow(dat),
  all(is.finite(probability_prediction$probability)),
  identical(dim(sim), c(nrow(dat), 2L)),
  inherits(model_check, "gamlss_longitudinal_check"),
  all(c(
    "empirical_overlay", "rosenblatt_qq", "residual_lag_correlation"
  ) %in% names(copula_check$plots)),
  is.data.frame(report),
  inherits(specification, "gamlss_longitudinal_model_spec"),
  inherits(benchmark, "gamlss_longitudinal_benchmark"),
  all(benchmark$model_status$success)
)

message("All installation workflow assertions passed.")
```
